game.title: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles

roadmap.title: Enhanced prologue and Chapter 1 setup
roadmap.description: Play the Enhanced version, clear the prologue and Chapter 1, learn and use an ability, change jobs, recruit a generic unit, collect a crystal and buried item, and read five Chronicle person entries.

roadmap.title: Chapter 2 and Mustadio safeguard
roadmap.description: Start errands, recruit and breed the Araguay Woods Chocobo, mount it, master one job, recruit Mustadio permanently, watch Seekers of the Stone, and complete Chapter 2.

roadmap.title: Chapter 3 jobs and combat counters
roadmap.description: Open the Poachers’ Den, build job access while raising five units, work through every ability-specific counter, read the Scriptures of Germonique, and complete Chapter 3.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4 missable scene and side cleanup
roadmap.description: Immediately visit Goug with Mustadio, reach level 50 with Ramza, breed and process ten unique poacher rewards, and complete all 96 errands plus the two associated titles.

roadmap.title: All jobs and Midlight’s Deep
roadmap.description: Learn Ultima on Ramza at Limberry Castle Gate if he is the all-jobs candidate, reveal Midlight’s Deep after Mullonde, clear all ten floors, learn Zodiark, and finish every job ability on one unit.

roadmap.title: Final story and Akademy completion
roadmap.description: Finish Chapter 4, load the clear save for any cleanup, and complete every remaining Akademy Report entry.

achievements.description: Uncover every truth that had gone untold.
achievements.summary: Complete every other entry in @mechanic{Akademy Reports} on the same Enhanced-version save.

guide.context: Completion is checked against the in-game Akademy list, not the Steam profile, so every report must register in the save itself.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Main Menu > Akademy Reports}, complete every unfinished report, and return to the list after the final report registers.

achievements.description: Complete the prologue.
achievements.summary: Win the opening @loc{prologue battle} in the Enhanced version.

guide.context: The prologue is a single tutorial encounter in which Ramza is the only directly controlled ally.

steps.text: Follow the combat tutorial and defeat the prologue enemies to advance into Chapter 1.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 1, The Meager.
achievements.summary: Complete all Chapter 1 story battles through @loc{Zeikden Fortress}.

guide.context: Chapter 1 contains ten story battles after the prologue and has no difficulty requirement.

steps.text: Follow the red story destinations and win the battle at @loc{Zeikden Fortress} to finish Chapter 1.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 2, The Manipulative & the Subservient.
achievements.summary: Complete all Chapter 2 story battles and advance into Chapter 3.

guide.context: Chapter 2 introduces errands, monster recruitment, and Mustadio; accepting Mustadio permanently protects two later Chronicle achievements.

steps.text: When @npc{Mustadio} offers to join, recruit him and keep him alive in the roster.
Continue through every red story destination until the Chapter 2 finale is complete.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 3, The Valiant.
achievements.summary: Complete all Chapter 3 story battles through the @loc{Orbonne Monastery} sequence.

guide.context: The Orbonne sequence also awards the Scriptures of Germonique, which becomes readable from the Chronicle afterward.

steps.text: Follow the Chapter 3 story route, prepare before its sequential battles, and clear the full @loc{Orbonne Monastery} sequence.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 4, In the Name of Love.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 4 by winning the final battle at @loc{Necrohol — Airship Graveyard}.

guide.context: The final battles are sequential, but a clear save returns to the world map before that sequence for unfinished side content.

steps.text: Prepare the active party, enter the final sequence, and defeat the last encounter at @loc{Necrohol — Airship Graveyard}.

achievements.description: Reach level 30 or above with five different party members.
achievements.summary: Keep five rostered party members at @mechanic{level 30} or higher at the same time.

guide.context: Levels are counted per character; five qualifying units must coexist in the roster.

steps.text: Deploy the same five party members through story or random battles until each unit’s status screen shows level 30 or above.

achievements.description: Reach level 40 or above with five different party members.
achievements.summary: Keep five rostered party members at @mechanic{level 40} or higher at the same time.

guide.context: Chapter 4 and Midlight’s Deep provide further experience if the core five finish Chapter 3 below level 40.

steps.text: Continue using five retained party members until each unit’s status screen shows level 40 or above.

achievements.description: Reach level 50 with Ramza.
achievements.summary: Raise @npc{Ramza} to @mechanic{level 50}.

guide.context: Ramza cannot be sent on errands, so his remaining experience must come from deployed combat.

steps.text: Deploy Ramza in story, random, or Midlight’s Deep battles until his status screen shows level 50.

achievements.description: Take on an errand at a tavern.
achievements.summary: From Chapter 2 onward, dispatch a party from any @loc{tavern} on one errand.

guide.context: Errands consume in-game days and return their assigned generic units with JP and a result after travel advances the calendar.

steps.text: Enter a tavern, open @mechanic{Errands}, select an available job, choose up to three generic units, select a date range, and confirm the dispatch; Ramza and unique units cannot be assigned.

achievements.description: Earn the title of Master Treasure Hunter.
achievements.summary: Earn the @mechanic{Master Treasure Hunter} title by completing the full errand collection.

guide.context: The title is awarded automatically during the 96-errand completion route; it is not tied to buried battlefield items.

steps.text: Finish every regular and seasonal tavern errand until the treasure collection awards the Master Treasure Hunter title.

achievements.description: Earn the title of Master Adventurer.
achievements.summary: Earn the @mechanic{Master Adventurer} title by completing the full errand collection.

guide.context: The title tracks adventuring locations discovered through errands and arrives naturally while finishing the entire set.

steps.text: Finish every regular and seasonal tavern errand until the location collection awards the Master Adventurer title.

achievements.description: Achieve great success in every errand.
achievements.summary: Complete all @mechanic{96 tavern errands}, including the four month-specific contests.

guide.context: A failed errand has no permanent consequence and reappears after one in-game month; routes can be temporarily locked by story progress.

steps.text: Before each major story advance, visit available settlements and complete every errand shown in their taverns.

Complete @mechanic{The Gariland Magick Melee} in Gariland during Virgo, @mechanic{The Zaland Melee} in Zaland during Aries, @mechanic{Goug Artificers’ Contest} in Goug during Sagittarius, and @mechanic{The Yardrow Melee} in Yardrow during Cancer.

Open the world-map location list, visit every settlement still marked with unfinished errands, and repeat failures after advancing one month until all 96 return the literal @mechanic{Great Success} result with a gold stamp.

achievements.description: Recruit a new party member from the warriors' guild.
achievements.summary: Recruit any new party member from a @loc{warriors’ guild} after the first Chapter 1 battle.

guide.context: The warriors’ guild opens with party management after the Magick City of Gariland battle.

steps.text: Enter a warriors’ guild, choose @mechanic{Recruit}, select a generic unit, and confirm that unit’s addition to the roster.

achievements.description: Use the services of a poachers' den.
achievements.summary: Process one monster carcass at a @loc{Poachers’ Den} after the feature opens in Chapter 3.

guide.context: You can first find Poachers’ Dens at Merchant City of Dorter and Port City of Warjilis; Trade City of Sal Ghidos gains one later.

steps.text: Equip @mechanic{Poach} and kill a monster with the normal @mechanic{Attack} command to collect its carcass.
Visit a Poachers’ Den, open @mechanic{Process Carcasses}, and exchange the carcass for its item.

achievements.description: Have ten different items produced at a poachers' den that cannot be purchased from outfitters.
achievements.summary: Process @item{ten different poacher-only items} whose menu entries display the poacher icon.

guide.context: Breed lower monster forms by leaving roster space and advancing days; kill a bred ally with a normal Attack from a unit equipped with Poach, then reload the turn-start autosave when the wrong carcass drops.

collectibles.name: Barrette
collectibles.method: Breed a Chocobo until a Red Chocobo hatches, poach its rare carcass, and process it.

collectibles.name: Holy Lance
collectibles.method: Recruit a Wisenkin or Sekhret, breed Sekhret, poach its normal carcass, and process it.

collectibles.name: Ivory Pole
collectibles.method: Poach the same Sekhret family until its rare carcass drops, then process it.

collectibles.name: Healing Staff
collectibles.method: Recruit a Dryad-family monster, breed a Dryad, poach its rare carcass, and process it.

collectibles.name: Faerie Harp
collectibles.method: Breed the Dryad family until a Treant hatches, poach its rare carcass, and process it.

collectibles.name: Defender
collectibles.method: Breed the Dryad family until an Elder Treant hatches, poach its rare carcass, and process it.

collectibles.name: Cachusha
collectibles.method: Recruit a Pig, poach its rare carcass, and process it.

collectibles.name: Chantage
collectibles.method: Breed the Pig family until a Swine hatches, poach its normal carcass, and process it.

collectibles.name: Nagnarok
collectibles.method: Poach a Swine until its rare carcass drops, then process it.

collectibles.name: Ribbon
collectibles.method: Breed the Pig family until a Wild Boar hatches, poach its normal carcass, and process it.

achievements.description: Change the job of a party member.
achievements.summary: After the @loc{Magick City of Gariland} battle unlocks Jobs, change a party member to another job.

guide.context: Jobs become manageable after the first Chapter 1 battle, and new jobs unlock through levels in prerequisite jobs.

steps.text: Open a unit’s status screen, select @mechanic{Jobs}, choose a different unlocked job, and confirm the change.

achievements.description: Learn an ability with a party member.
achievements.summary: Spend JP to learn any ability with one party member.

guide.context: Successful actions award JP to the acting unit’s current job; ineffective actions do not award JP.

steps.text: Open a unit’s @mechanic{Abilities} menu, select the current job, purchase any affordable ability, and confirm @mechanic{Learn}.

achievements.description: Use an action ability with a party member during battle.
achievements.summary: Perform any party member’s action ability successfully in a battle.

guide.context: An action must produce its normal effect; the Squire’s zero-MP Focus is available early and cannot miss.

steps.text: On a party member’s turn, open @mechanic{Abilities}, select an action such as @mechanic{Focus}, choose its target if prompted, and let it resolve.

achievements.description: Learn all the abilities of a single job with one party member.
achievements.summary: Learn every listed ability of one job with a single party member.

guide.context: Reaching job level 8 does not guarantee mastery; every ability in that job’s list must be purchased or inherited.

steps.text: Keep one unit in a chosen job, earn JP with successful actions, and purchase every remaining entry in that job’s Abilities list.

achievements.description: Learn all the abilities of every job with one party member.
achievements.sortReason: Ramza’s Ultima opportunities are limited, and Zodiark is safest during the END boss battle.
achievements.summary: Learn every ability from every job with one party member; if @npc{Ramza} is that unit, he must also learn @mechanic{Ultima}.

guide.context: Patch 1.4.0 fixed the former last-ability report bug. JP Boost, Focus loops, and human-enemy crystals shorten the grind, but Ultima has limited story opportunities.

steps.text: If Ramza is the candidate, save before @loc{Limberry Castle Gate}, set him to @mechanic{Gallant Knight}, equip @item{Black Garb} and @item{Nu Khai Armband}, and let @npc{Celia} hit him with Ultima while he survives without Stone or Toad; accept the learn prompt.

At @loc{Midlight’s Deep — END}, set the candidate to @mechanic{Summoner}, equip @mechanic{Mana Shield}, survive @enemy{Serpentarius’s Zodiark} without Stone or Toad, and accept the learn prompt; reload the pre-cast autosave if learning fails.
Use @mechanic{JP Boost} and repeated successful actions to buy every remaining ability in every job, then load the save and open the main menu if the Akademy check does not appear immediately.

achievements.description: Knock an enemy away with "Counter Tackle."
achievements.summary: Use @mechanic{Counter Tackle} to knock an adjacent enemy one tile away.

guide.context: Counter Tackle is a Squire reaction ability and can trigger only when an adjacent attack activates the reaction.

steps.text: Equip Counter Tackle, stand beside a melee enemy with an empty tile directly behind that attacker, and let the enemy attack until the reaction activates and pushes it backward one tile.

achievements.description: Remove an ally's status ailment or restore their HP five times using "Throw Items."
achievements.summary: Restore ally HP or remove an ally’s ailment with @mechanic{Throw Items} five times.

guide.context: Each item must change the target’s current state; healing a full-health ally or treating no ailment does not count.

steps.text: Equip Throw Items and, on five separate actions, use a suitable restorative item on an injured or afflicted ally within range.

achievements.description: Destroy enemy equipment using Arts of War abilities five times.
achievements.summary: Destroy equipment worn by human enemies with @mechanic{Arts of War} five times.

guide.context: Monster targets cannot contribute because they do not carry qualifying equipment.

steps.text: Against equipped human enemies, use Knight Arts of War such as @mechanic{Rend Weapon}, @mechanic{Rend Helm}, or @mechanic{Rend Armor} until five pieces are successfully destroyed.

achievements.description: Inflict damage on enemies five times using Aim abilities.
achievements.summary: Damage enemies with Archer @mechanic{Aim} abilities five times.

guide.context: Aim delays the shot for extra power, so stationary or disabled targets are more reliable.

steps.text: Equip Aim, select an enemy that will remain in range, and let five Aim attacks resolve for damage.

achievements.description: Simultaneously inflict damage on two or more enemies with "Shockwave" five times.
achievements.summary: Damage at least two enemies with one @mechanic{Shockwave}, five separate times.

guide.context: Shockwave travels in a straight line from the Monk, so enemy alignment matters more than adjacency.

steps.text: Line up two or more enemies along Shockwave’s path and land the multi-target hit; repeat until five casts have each damaged at least two enemies.

achievements.description: Deal the felling blow to five enemies with the White Magick ability "Holy."
achievements.summary: Finish five enemies by casting the White Magick spell @mechanic{Holy}.

guide.context: Only the final blow counts, so lower each target’s HP before spending Holy’s MP and cast time.

steps.text: Weaken five enemies individually, cast Holy from a White Magick user, and make sure each spell resolves as that enemy’s killing blow.

achievements.description: Inflict damage on an enemy with a Black Magick ability targeted on a tile. Do this five times.
achievements.summary: Target Black Magick on a battlefield tile and damage an enemy, five separate times.

guide.context: One cast counts once even if it hits several enemies; the targeting prompt allows an empty tile or the tile beneath a unit.

steps.text: Choose a Black Magick spell, switch its target to a tile, place the area over an enemy, and repeat until five tile-targeted casts deal damage.

achievements.description: Successfully use "Teleport" five times.
achievements.summary: Complete five successful movements with the Time Mage ability @mechanic{Teleport}.

guide.context: Teleport can ignore obstacles and elevation, but failure chance rises with distance.

steps.text: Equip Teleport, choose nearby destination tiles during successive turns, and finish five movements that successfully relocate the unit.

achievements.description: Summon five different espers in battle.
achievements.summary: Use five different Summoner @mechanic{esper abilities} in battle.

guide.context: Distinct learned summons are required; repeating one esper does not add another unique use.

steps.text: Learn at least five Summoner abilities, enter battle with sufficient MP, and successfully cast five differently named espers.

achievements.description: Successfully use "Poach" five times.
achievements.summary: Kill five monsters with normal Attacks from a unit equipped with @mechanic{Poach}.

guide.context: Poach is a Thief support ability; ability damage cannot convert the killing blow into a carcass.

steps.text: Equip Poach, weaken a monster, finish it with the base @mechanic{Attack} command, and repeat until five successful poaches have produced carcasses.

achievements.description: Successfully use "Entice" five times.
achievements.summary: Successfully recruit five enemy units with the Orator action @mechanic{Entice}.

guide.context: The displayed success chance changes with Faith and zodiac compatibility, so another target may be much easier even within the same enemy family.

steps.text: Deploy an Orator, inspect Entice’s displayed chance on each enemy, cast it on favorable targets, and finish five successful conversions.

achievements.description: Inflict status ailments on enemies five times with Mystic Arts abilities.
achievements.summary: Inflict status ailments on enemies with @mechanic{Mystic Arts} five times.

guide.context: Immune or already afflicted targets do not receive a new ailment, so verify the preview and target status first.

steps.text: Use Mystic Arts such as a disabling or weakening spell on vulnerable enemies until five casts successfully apply an ailment.

achievements.description: Inflict damage on enemies with five different Geomancy abilities.
achievements.summary: Damage enemies with five different @mechanic{Geomancy abilities}.

guide.context: Geomancy chooses its available action from the ground beneath the caster, so varied terrain exposes different abilities.

steps.text: Move a Geomancer across five terrain types, use the corresponding differently named Geomancy action from each tile, and damage an enemy with every one.

achievements.description: Inflict damage on enemies with "Jump" five times.
achievements.summary: Damage enemies with the Dragoon action @mechanic{Jump} five times.

guide.context: Jump resolves after a delay and can miss if the target moves; speed gear or Immobilize makes the landing more reliable.

steps.text: Target enemies that just acted or cannot move, select Jump, and repeat until five delayed landings deal damage.

achievements.description: Utilize the hidden power of five different katana with "Iaido."
achievements.summary: Activate five different Samurai @mechanic{Iaido abilities} using five named katana.

guide.context: Iaido draws the matching katana from shared inventory and may destroy it, even though the weapon need not be equipped.

steps.text: Keep five different katana in inventory, learn their five Iaido actions, and successfully activate each differently named action once.

achievements.description: Inflict damage on enemies with "Throw" five times.
achievements.summary: Damage enemies with Ninja @mechanic{Throw} attacks five times.

guide.context: Thrown weapons and items are permanently consumed, and their category must first be learned in the Ninja ability list.

steps.text: Stock expendable items, learn the matching Throw category, and land five Throw attacks on enemies.

achievements.description: Inflict damage on three or more enemies at once with Arithmeticks abilities without harming an ally.
achievements.summary: Use @mechanic{Arithmeticks} to damage at least three enemies at once without damaging an ally.

guide.context: Arithmeticks combines EXP, Level, CT, or Height with a divisor and targets every matching unit; the confirmation preview shows the full affected set.

steps.text: Enter an undead-heavy encounter at @loc{The Yuguewood} or the Chapter 4 battlefield before Limberry Castle with an Arithmetician who knows Cura and several target formulas.
Inspect enemy values, choose EXP, Level, CT, or Height plus a divisor shared by at least three undead enemies, and confirm that the targeting preview contains the required enemies.
Cast @mechanic{Cura} through Arithmeticks; it must damage at least three undead enemies while no ally takes damage.

achievements.description: Utilize the power of five different Bardsong abilities.
achievements.summary: Apply buffs with five different Bard @mechanic{Bardsong abilities}.

guide.context: Bardsong continues charging until its effect resolves for the whole allied party; issuing another action interrupts the song.

steps.text: Place a Bard away from danger, start one Bardsong, wait for its party-wide effect, and repeat with four other differently named songs.

achievements.description: Inflict a status ailment on three or more enemies at once with Forbidden Dance five times.
achievements.summary: Use @mechanic{Forbidden Dance} to ail at least three enemies, five separate times.

guide.context: Forbidden Dance is a continuous Dancer action with a separate 50% ailment chance per enemy, so larger enemy groups improve each attempt.

steps.text: Deploy a Dancer against a large group, keep the Dancer uninterrupted until Forbidden Dance resolves, and repeat until five performances each afflict at least three enemies.

achievements.description: Use Mimic five times.
achievements.summary: Have a deployed Mime automatically copy party actions with @mechanic{Mimic} five times.

guide.context: Mime copies standard job actions in the direction it faces; the copied action can count even when it misses.

steps.text: Deploy a Mime, face it safely, and have other party members use copyable actions such as Focus until five automatic Mimic activations occur.

achievements.description: Obtain a buried item during battle.
achievements.summary: Use @mechanic{Treasure Hunter} to uncover one buried battlefield item.

guide.context: Each battle map has fixed treasure tiles; a Chemist has the search innately, while other jobs require the Chemist movement ability.

steps.text: On @loc{Midlight's Deep — YROTCIV}, deploy a Chemist or equip Treasure Hunter, then end that unit's movement on grid cell @loc{C4}, a starting-area tile marked for buried treasure.

achievements.description: Acquire an ability from a crystal.
achievements.summary: Inherit an ability from a crystal left by a defeated human unit.

guide.context: A dead human’s three-heart timer can end as either a chest or crystal; monsters cannot provide ability crystals.

steps.text: Defeat a human enemy and keep the battle active until its three-heart countdown reaches zero and leaves a crystal.
Move a compatible party member onto the crystal and choose an offered ability to learn it.

achievements.description: Mount a chocobo.
achievements.summary: Move a humanoid party member onto a deployed @npc{Chocobo} and mount it.

guide.context: The earliest guaranteed candidate is the Chocobo saved and recruited during the Chapter 2 Araguay Woods story battle.

steps.text: Deploy a Chocobo and a humanoid ally, select a movement destination on the Chocobo’s occupied tile, and accept the mount prompt.

achievements.description: Hatch a creature egg.
achievements.summary: Keep a recruited monster in the roster and advance world-map days until one of its eggs hatches.

guide.context: The Chapter 2 Araguay Woods Chocobo can join without Entice; retained monsters continue laying eggs when roster space is available.

steps.text: Save the Chocobo at @loc{Araguay Woods} and recruit it after battle, or recruit another monster with Entice or Tame.
Keep at least one roster slot free and repeatedly travel between two world-map locations until an egg appears and hatches automatically.

achievements.description: Read about five different people in the Encyclopedia section of the Chronicle.
achievements.summary: View five different people under @mechanic{Chronicle > Encyclopedia > Persons}.

guide.context: The Chronicle unlocks once the opening Chapter 1 fight in the Magick City of Gariland is complete.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Main Menu > Chronicle > Encyclopedia > Persons} and open five differently named person entries.

achievements.description: Read the Scriptures of Germonique to the end in the Reading Materials section of the Chronicle.
achievements.summary: Read all of @item{The Scriptures of Germonique} under Chronicle’s Reading Materials.

guide.context: The document is awarded automatically after the Chapter 3 Orbonne Monastery battle sequence.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Chronicle > Reading Materials > Scriptures of Germonique} and advance through every page until the text ends.

achievements.description: Watch the scene Seekers of the Stone in the Events section of the Chronicle.
achievements.sortReason: Mustadio must remain in the roster before this Chronicle event becomes available.
achievements.summary: Keep @npc{Mustadio} and watch @mechanic{Seekers of the Stone} after Lionel Castle in Chapter 2.

guide.context: Declining Mustadio, dismissing him, or allowing permanent death removes this event from the current playthrough.

steps.text: Recruit Mustadio when offered and keep him alive in the roster.
After progressing beyond @loc{Lionel Castle}, open @mechanic{Chronicle > Events > Seekers of the Stone} and play the scene to its end.

achievements.description: Watch the scene The Metallic Sphere.
achievements.sortReason: The Metallic Sphere scene requires Mustadio to remain in the roster.
achievements.summary: Keep @npc{Mustadio} and trigger @mechanic{The Metallic Sphere} at Goug in Chapter 4.

guide.context: The optional Goug scene cannot occur in a playthrough where Mustadio was declined, dismissed, or permanently lost.

steps.text: At the start of Chapter 4 or later, keep Mustadio in the roster and travel to @loc{Clockwork City of Goug}; let The Metallic Sphere scene finish.

achievements.description: Complete all levels of Midlight's Deep.
achievements.summary: After Mullonde, visit @loc{Port City of Warjilis} to reveal @loc{Midlight's Deep}, then clear all ten floors through @loc{END}.

guide.context: Each of the first nine floors is dark, and the player must test one of five possible passage tiles. Read every direction from the named starting-grid anchor while facing the same way as the party's initial formation; leave an enemy alive, test candidates with Treasure Hunter until @mechanic{Found a passage leading deeper} appears, then finish the battle.

collectibles.name: NOISSIM
collectibles.method: Test Left 3 at height 18; Left 9 at height 2; Up 1 and Left 6 at height 7; Up 6 and Left 8 at height 1; or Up 8 and Left 8 at height 1, then defeat the remaining enemies.

collectibles.name: TERMINATION
collectibles.method: Test Up 2 and Right 5 at height 8; Up 7 and Right 4 at height 5; Up 10 and Left 1 at height 1; Up 11 and Left 3 at height 2; or Up 11 and Right 5 at height 1.

collectibles.name: DELTA
collectibles.method: Test Up 4 and Right 2 at height 1; Up 7 and Left 2 at height 2.5; Up 7 and Left 3 at height 6; Up 13 and Left 3 at height 0; or Up 14 and Right 4 at height 0.

collectibles.name: VALKYRIES
collectibles.method: Test Left 8 at height 3; Left 11 and Up 7 at height 3; Left 13 and Up 8 at height 2; Left 14 and Up 6 at height 1; or Left 15 and Up 4 at height 1.

collectibles.name: YROTCIV
collectibles.method: Test Up 4 at height 10; Up 4 and Left 3 at height 0; Up 6 and Left 1 at height 0; Up 6 and Right 2 at height 0; or Up 8 and Left 3 at height 1.

collectibles.name: TIGER
collectibles.method: Test Right 5 and Up 2 at height 2; Right 8 and Up 8 at height 0; Right 9 and Up 3 at height 1; Right 10 at height 0; or Right 10 and Up 9 at height 0.

collectibles.name: BRIDGE
collectibles.method: Test Right 8 at height 0; Up 1 and Right 6 at height 0; Up 6 and Right 6 at height 2; Up 8 and Right 3 at height 7; or Up 12 and Right 4 at height 5.

collectibles.name: VOYAGE
collectibles.method: Test Right 1 at height 3; Right 2 at height 3; Up 3 and Right 1 at height 3; Up 3 and Left 8 at height 9; or Up 8 and Left 6 at height 3.

collectibles.name: HORROR
collectibles.method: Test Back 1 and Right 3 at height 1; Up 2 and Right 1 at height 2; Up 4 and Right 3 at height 2; Up 6 and Right 1 at height 4; or Left 7 at height 2.

collectibles.name: END
collectibles.method: Defeat the Reavers first, keep guest Byblos alive if recruitment is desired, then defeat Serpentarius; a Summoner with Mana Shield can survive Zodiark and accept its learn prompt here.
